text_ru: Пало от бескормицы до приёмки: {heads} гол. ({share} % стада).
context: Строка годовой книги председателя. Записывает число животных, павших от бескормицы в годы до приёмки хозяйства, и долю падежа в стаде. Это запись убытка, а не обвинение или извещение о суде. «гол.» означает «голов».
meaning: Take-over-year starvation deaths are booked rather than tried; show raw animal heads and the host-computed weighted herd share
intent: Record the supplied annual loss in the bookkeeper register without threatening a district trial
keep: No species inferred; raw heads are not conditional heads; share is the supplied weighted share not heads divided by a guessed herd total; no date, warning or consequence added
binding_note: Task #1588 after #1585. For displayed book year Y read rules.trial.pre_acceptance.Y.heads and .share_permille. heads is the recorded integer raw animal count; share = share_permille / 10 formatted with exactly one decimal in the target locale, no percent suffix because source supplies %.
